scope: Local shared-file sessions and compatible versions already installed by a plugin manager; no model or publication requests

cases.criterion: A newer cached directory alone does not trigger an update. Follow the same enabled installed plugin and reject incompatible protocols and foreign paths.
An idle browser picks up the installed update automatically at the same address. Poem identity, exact saved text, revision history and selected client remain intact.
An open bulk/line/word editor, title input or unsent question prevents automatic reload. Preserve actual buffer text, even when another tab restarts the compatible server.
Wait for acknowledgement of the latest save. A stale or failed save retains its draft and never reloads or overwrites another writer's revision.
Typing during an asynchronous version check or server restart prevents reload until that edit is saved or explicitly cancelled.
A failed successor returns to the working version at the same address and shows a notice without repeatedly trying that failed target.
Real Claude/Codex install/update commands yield detectable packages; handoffs preserve Claude, Codex and explicit manual selections without making a model request.

browser_steps: Open an isolated versioned install's shared poem in a real browser. Begin bulk editing and type a visibly different unsaved line.
Point only the fixture's installed-plugin record at its compatible newer package. Wait for the pending-update message; verify the textarea and original saved file remain unchanged.
Save the draft in the browser and wait for acknowledgement and automatic reconnect/reload. Verify the same address and exact saved text through the browser and CLI, with only one new poem revision.

Start another unsaved draft, advance the saved poem through conditional CLI update, and make a newer runtime available. Confirm no reload or overwrite, a visible save conflict, and continued access to the unsaved buffer.
